add_file_descriptor_proto: add a FileDescriptorProto to the DescriptorDatabase and index its message types, enums, extensions, and services
find_file_by_name: find a file descriptor proto by its proto file name in the DescriptorDatabase
find_file_containing_symbol: find the file descriptor proto containing a fully qualified symbol like package.Message in the database
handle_conflicting_definitions: handle DescriptorDatabaseConflictingDefinitionError when adding a proto with the same name but different descriptor
extract_symbols_from_descriptor: extract all fully qualified symbol names from a descriptor proto including nested types and enums
